_meta.title: ReturnWise Fictional Store Return Policy
_meta.disclaimer: These are entirely fictional policies created for a college Agentic AI demonstration project. They do not represent the policies of any real retailer.

global_rules.note: The reference date is pinned so all return-window calculations are reproducible.
global_rules.boundary: Inclusive start (delivery date counts as day 0). A 30-day window expires after day 30, i.e. delivery_date + 30 days >= reference_date is within window.

electronics.notes: Electronics may be returned within 30 days of delivery for any reason. Damaged items are accepted with photo evidence (simulated). Original packaging not required for this PoC.

clothing.notes: Clothing items may be returned within 60 days. Damaged or defective items accepted. Changed-mind returns accepted within window.

books.notes: Books may be returned within 30 days if unread or damaged. Wrong-item returns always accepted within window.

furniture.notes: Furniture has a shorter 14-day return window due to logistics. Damaged-on-arrival claims accepted within 14 days.

toys.notes: Toys may be returned within 30 days. Safety defects are grounds for replacement or refund.

health_safety.notes: Health and safety items may only be replaced, not refunded, for hygiene reasons. Damaged items qualify for replacement within 30 days.

digital.notes: Digital goods (software licenses, e-books, streaming codes) are non-returnable once delivered. No exceptions.

perishable.notes: Perishable food items are non-returnable due to health regulations.

intimate_apparel.notes: Intimate apparel is non-returnable for hygiene reasons.

sports.notes: Sports equipment may be returned within 30 days. Defective items may be returned for refund or replacement.

appliances.notes: Home appliances may be returned within 30 days. Damaged or defective items accepted.

defective.description: Item stopped working or never worked correctly.
defective.notes: Defective claims are accepted for all returnable categories if within return window.

wrong_item.description: Customer received a different item than ordered.
wrong_item.notes: Wrong-item claims are accepted for returnable categories if within window and the order is delivered. Non-returnable categories are rejected for every reason (the PoC does not model seller-error exceptions).

damaged.notes: Only categories with damaged_allowed=true qualify. Non-returnable categories are excluded.

changed_mind.description: Customer no longer wants the item.
changed_mind.notes: Accepted for all returnable categories within the return window. Not accepted for restricted categories.

other.notes: Reason 'other' always triggers a manual review recommendation.
